option.value:
from dotenv import load_dotenv import warnings
load_dotenv() from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate from langchain_google_vertexai import ChatVertexAI
# Suppress deprecation warning - ChatVertexAI is the correct choice for service accounts warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)
llm = ChatVertexAI( model="gemini-2.5-flash", location="us-central1" ) prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages( [ ("system", "You are an expert Python teacher."), ("human", "Explain {topic} with examples.") ] )
chain = prompt | llm
response = chain.invoke( {"topic": "List comprehensions"} )
def main(): print("Hello from langchain-course!") print(response)
if __name__ == "__main__": main()
